description: Source code for the implementation of the User-Plane message decoder in the Open Fronthaul protocol, including header decoding, section parsing, IQ data decompression, and message validation.

classes.name: uplane_message_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the User-Plane message decoder with methods for decoding headers, sections, and IQ data.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a message into results, processing header and sections.

methods.name: decode_header
methods.description: Decodes the User-Plane message header and populates parameters.

methods.name: decode_all_sections
methods.description: Decodes all sections within a message.

methods.name: decode_section
methods.description: Decodes a single section, including header, compression, and IQ data.

methods.name: decode_compression_length
methods.description: Decodes the length of compressed data if applicable.

methods.name: decode_iq_data
methods.description: Decompresses IQ samples from the message.

methods.name: is_header_valid
methods.description: Validates the header parameters against expected values.

methods.name: check_iq_data_size
methods.description: Checks if the message contains enough bytes for IQ data based on parameters.
